messages:
emma_sales: Quick sync — MedSync POC kickoff asks: they want a 2-week eval to validate: 1) realtime visit-summary generation (3200 tokens avg), 2) retrieval + rerank over patient notes, 3) tool-calling to pull lab results. Need to confirm model fit, context length, and a success criteria checklist.
raj_se: @emma_sales sounds good. Primary tech questions: context window to keep encounter + prior notes, tool calling latency, and embedding quality for rerank. Do they need streaming?
emma_sales: They prefer near-real-time (<300ms median per token) for UI streaming but will accept 500ms if batching helps cost. Also concerned about PHI in logs — legal wants strict controls.
sophie_soleng: For success criteria propose: (A) ROUGE-like overlap >= 0.65 vs human summaries on 50 eval cases, (B) rerank MRR > 0.7 on retrieval tasks, (C) end-to-end 90th pctl latency < 1s for summary with tool calls included. Thoughts?
raj_se: Agree. Add quality guard: hallucination rate < 5% on a targeted prompt set. We'll run a small eval harness with seed prompts.
liam_infra: Architecture notes: hosted API can prototype quickly but Dedicated gives predictable throughput for tool-calling spikes. For 2-week POC we can do hosted + a temporary dedicated node if they want consistent SLOs. Pricing note: short dedicated bursts require a min commit — we can offer a temporary trial rate, pinging sales ops.
security_bot: FYI — customer submitted an initial security questionnaire. Key asks: data residency, KMS integration, audit logs retention. Recommend sending standard Private deployment FAQ.
emma_sales: OK please list exact ask items we need to answer for the RFP and POC sign-off so I can reply. Also they asked about 32k context — false alarm, only need ~8k for now but could grow.
raj_se: Action list from eng side: 1) confirm model candidates (we should test an 8k Llama-variant and a 32k-optimized model), 2) craft prompt set (50 visit summaries + 20 rerank queries), 3) run embeddings similarity baseline (cosine) and a small reranker evaluation.
sophie_soleng: I'll own success criteria doc and the prompt/eval spreadsheet. Quick draft metric table: 
```
- Summarization: ROUGE-L / BLEU / qualitative checklist
- Rerank: MRR, Recall@5
- Tool calls: P95 latency, error rate
- Cost: tokens per summary, estimated $/summary
```
emma_sales: Great. Timeline: share eval harness by Mon (3 business days), run quick 50-case pass mid-next-week, present results end of week. Can eng commit?
raj_se: Yes. I'll spin up the eval infra and provide model perf numbers. Will we allow KV/prefix caching for repeated patients? That affects latency/cost tradeoffs.
liam_infra: We can enable KV cache on the runtime. For the POC config we should set `cache_ttl=12h` and `batching=max_delay_ms=20` to mimic production. Also note tool-call connectors will add ~60-120ms depending on downstream DB.
emma_sales: Pricing q from customer: if this goes to pilot (3 months, 10k summaries/day) what are ballpark costs and discount thresholds?
liam_infra: Rough estimate: hosted token rate -> $0.0008 /k token for generation; embeddings and rerank add extra. For pilot we'd propose Dedicated commitment or volume discount. I'll ask finance for a formal quote once scope locked.
security_bot: For PHI: recommend Private deployment or Dedicated with strict log redaction + KMS. Provide them our SOC2 + data flow diagram.
sophie_soleng: I'll attach the prompt examples and candidate eval scripts to the spreadsheet. @raj_se can you add the model config snippets? Example snippet to reproduce prompt:
```
PROMPT = "Summarize visit in bullet points. Include diagnosis, meds, next steps. Keep under 300 tokens."
EVAL = run_human_eval(seed_set, model, metrics=[rouge_l, mrr])
```
raj_se: Added model configs. We'll test `redwood-8k-v1` and `redwood-32k-compat-v1` quantized runs. Will include tool-call stubs and a reranker using `annoy` for speed.
emma_sales: OK final ask for sales reply: 1) confirm timeline + who owns evals, 2) list security docs we'll send, 3) outline pilot pricing approach, 4) call next Tue to align. I'll reply to customer after we confirm. :thumbsup:
liam_infra: I'll loop in finance and eng-infra for the pricing + dedicated trial details.
security_bot: I'll package SOC2 + KMS integration notes + data retention policy.
emma_sales: Thanks all — will draft reply in thread and tag for approvals before sending. :rocket:
